rows.source: Binance USD-M monthly 8h klines; canonical bars.parquet
rows.lag: open_time+8h<=Monday decision; 21 most-recent returns skipped from coefficient/formation window
rows.transform: adjacent log returns; 189-return OLS with intercept on contemporaneous BTC; last-63 residual sum divided by residual RMS*sqrt(63)
rows.missing: any gap, nonpositive/missing close, missing BTC row, OLS denominator<=1e-12, or residual RMS<=1e-8 makes asset unscorable
rows.fit_scope: decision-local past-only OLS; no persisted coefficients

rows.field: PIT symbol membership and executable-open flag
rows.source: canonical membership.parquet and Binance transaction-bar availability
rows.transform: ranking universe only; BTC factor-only; liquidity rank not alpha
rows.missing: absent means ineligible; fewer than 12 scorable non-BTC names means flat

rows.field: actual funding rate and funding mark
rows.source: Binance funding archives/official gap REST; canonical funding.parquet
rows.available_time: strictly past to strategy; exact event to evaluator
rows.missing: snapshot/evaluator fails closed; never impute or assume 8h
